title: When LLM-Generated Refactorings Ripple: An Empirical Study of Repository Adoption Readiness
title_zh: 当LLM生成的重构产生涟漪效应时：一项关于仓库采用就绪度的实证研究

paragraphs.en: 总结：研究对15个Java仓库1500次LLM重构生成进行评估，发现约94%候选存在高契约或依赖风险，主张需仓库级分阶段验证。 Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to refactor source files, but file-local evaluations do not reveal changes to contracts, dependencies, or caller assumptions affecting repository adoption. To address this gap, we conduct 1,500 generation attempts across 150 production files from 15 open-source Java repositories, five LLM configurations, and two dependency-aware generation conditions: single-prompt refactoring and LangGraph-based multi-agent refactoring. Of these attempts, 1,455 yield complete candidates eligible for analysis. We evaluate these candidates using local changes, repository-facing structural indicators, detected caller impact, the behavioural-equivalence indicator, and available test evidence, and categorize them as Low-risk, Review-needed, High Contract/Dependency Risk, or Inconclusive. The results show that 1,365 candidates (93.8%) are classified as High Contract/Dependency Risk, whereas 106 (7.3%) have at least one detected broken downstream caller and 290 (19.9%) have a false behavioural-equivalence indicator; only eight satisfy the Low-risk criteria. Within the reason-covered subset, the High-risk rate decreases under more conservative dependency-delta thresholds, while 60 of the 65 candidates with conclusive targeted-test outcomes pass, including 50 classified as High risk. Paired analyses of 705 complete pairs identify no statistically significant generation-condition difference in the principal risk indicators, although model configurations differ in specific detected risk channels. These findings suggest that practitioners should treat LLM-generated refactorings as candidates requiring staged repository-level verification, while future research should validate screening and extraction precision and strengthen compilation, behavioural, and coordinated multi-file verification.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：研究对15个Java仓库的1500次LLM重构生成进行评估，发现约94%的候选存在高契约或依赖风险，主张需进行仓库级分阶段验证。大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于重构源文件，但仅针对单个文件的局部评估无法揭示对契约、依赖或调用方假设的更改，而这些更改会影响重构在仓库层面的采纳。 为弥补这一空白，我们在来自15个开源Java仓库的150个生产文件上进行了1500次生成尝试，涉及五种LLM配置和两种依赖感知的生成条件：单提示词重构和基于LangGraph的多智能体重构。 在这些尝试中，有1455次产出了可纳入分析的完整候选。 我们使用局部变更、面向仓库的结构性指标、检测到的调用方影响、行为等价性指标以及可用的测试证据来评估这些候选，并将其归类为低风险、需审查、高契约/依赖风险或无法判定。 结果显示，1365个候选（93.8%）被归类为高契约/依赖风险，其中106个（7.3%）至少存在一个检测到的下游调用方损坏，290个（19.9%）存在错误的行为等价性指标；仅有8个满足低风险标准。 在覆盖原因的子集中，当依赖差异阈值更为保守时，高风险率有所下降；而在65个具有可判定针对性测试结果的候选中，有60个通过测试，其中包括50个被归类为高风险的候选。 对705对完整配对进行的配对分析表明，主要风险指标上不存在统计上显著的生成条件差异，尽管不同模型配置在特定的检测风险渠道上有所不同。 这些发现表明，从业者应将LLM生成的重构视为需要仓库级分阶段验证的候选，而未来研究应验证筛选与提取的精度，并加强编译、行为以及协调式多文件验证。
